title: Long Trips and Long-Term Use
summary: This topic mixes long-trip comfort and efficiency comments with charging guidance, vehicle length remarks, and vague long-term references, so the examples are only partly coherent.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise comfort for adult passengers on long trips, strong long-distance efficiency, suitability for motorway travel, and helpful long-term battery charging guidance.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on unclear fast-charging instructions for long trips, which leaves the owner uncertain about using the vehicle on longer journeys.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention the vehicle being long, generic long drives or long trips, battery health over the long term, rear legroom, and long-term trust without clear evaluative sentiment in most fragments.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, limiting clear sentiment conclusions about this topic.
The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as trip comfort, charging practices, vehicle size, rear legroom, service trust, and generic long-term references.
Several fragments are too short or context-dependent to determine whether they are praising, criticizing, or simply describing the vehicle.
